name: Fullscreen Section Scroll
description: Full-screen image sections that slide over each other on wheel, touch or drag, with a parallax image shift and a per-letter random stagger heading reveal on each section.
contents: Full-viewport slides, each with a background image and a large centered heading
Small fixed header title at the top
behavior: Wheel, touch and pointer input advances to the next or previous section, looping at both ends
Sections wipe in with outer and inner wrapper offsets and a parallax image shift
Heading letters animate in with a random stagger
Input is ignored while a transition is running
editableByProps: Number of slides, heading text, images and per-slide image position
Header title, overlay gradient, text and background colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the character stagger style or delay
needsCodeEdit.where: stagger option in the targetHeadingChars fromTo call

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the parallax distance of the images

fixed: Takes over page scrolling: wheel, touch and pointer input are captured with preventDefault, so the page itself does not scroll
Sections are fixed to the viewport and the root fills the viewport height
